title: Robust and Fine-Grained Detection of AI Generated Texts
abstract: arXiv:2504.11952v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: An ideal detection system for machine generated content is supposed to work well on any generator as many more advanced LLMs come into existence day by day. Existing systems often struggle with accurately identifying AI-generated content over shorter texts. Further, not all texts might be entirely authored by a human or LLM, hence we focused more over partial cases i.e human-LLM co-authored texts. Our paper introduces a set of models built for the task of token classification which are trained on an extensive collection of human-machine co-authored texts, which performed well over texts of unseen domains, unseen generators, texts by non-native speakers and those with adversarial inputs. We also introduce a new dataset of over 2.4M such texts mostly co-authored by several popular proprietary LLMs over 23 languages. translated_title: 鲁棒且细粒度的AI生成文本检测
translated_abstract: 理想的机器生成内容检测系统应当能够在任何生成器上都表现良好，因为日益先进的LLM每天都在不断涌现。现有系统往往难以准确识别较短文本中的AI生成内容。此外，并非所有文本都完全由人类或大语言模型撰写，因此我们更加关注部分生成的情况，即人类与大语言模型共同创作的文本。本文介绍了一组为词元分类任务构建的模型，这些模型在海量人类与机器共同创作的文本集合上进行训练，在未见过的领域、未见过的生成器、非母语者撰写的文本以及含对抗性输入的文本上均表现良好。我们还引入了一个全新的数据集，包含超过240万条此类文本，其中大部分由多个流行的专有大语言模型以23种语言共同创作而成。我们还展示了模型在各领域和各生成器的每篇文本上的性能表现。
tldr: 本文提出一组基于词元分类的模型，能够鲁棒且细粒度地检测AI生成及人机共同创作的文本，并发布了涵盖23种语言、超过240万条文本的新数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a set of token classification models for robust and fine-grained detection of AI-generated and human-LLM co-authored texts, along with a new dataset of over 2.4M texts across 23 languages.
